Status (as of Oct 14, 2026): Built Aug 3 – Sept 30, 2026; final pavement markings were scheduled for the week of Sept 28. The city page had not yet posted a completion notice – confirm striping on the ground.

Also adds median refuge islands and rapid flashing beacons at Cambridge, Roseland, Franklin, Lay Blvd, Hays Park, Clinton and Egleston. Connects to the existing Portage St bike lanes north of Stockbridge.

features.n: Austin Lake Trail (Portage) – Zylman Ave to Nash Ave, under construction, opens 2027
features.d:
Status (as of Oct 14, 2026): Under construction. Final land acquired Sept 2025; tree removal winter 2025–26; completion expected 2027.
Facility: New 10-ft asphalt trail with 2-ft shoulders, ~1.8 mi (Portage project 2024005.01)
Starts at the Zylman Ave / Coxs Dr roundabout sidewalk, follows Coxs Dr and East Shore Dr, then the old rail bed along the east side of Austin Lake to Nash Ave. Route traced from the city's Austin Lake Trail property control map (May 2024).
Sources:
WKZO – Portage acquires final land for Austin Lake Trail (Sept 12, 2025)
City of Portage 2024–2030 CIP – Bikeways & Trailways
City of Portage / Viridis – Austin Lake Trail Property Control Map (May 28, 2024)

features.n: Austin Lake Trail (Portage) – Nash Ave to Vicksburg Trail, under construction, opens 2027
features.d:
Status (as of Oct 14, 2026): Under construction. Final land acquired Sept 2025; tree removal winter 2025–26; completion expected 2027.
Facility: New 10-ft asphalt trail with 2-ft shoulders, ~1.1 mi, including a boardwalk through the wetland (Portage project 2024005.02)
Follows the old rail bed south from Nash Ave to Portage's south city limit, where it connects to the existing Vicksburg Trail. Route traced from the city's Austin Lake Trail property control map (May 2024).
Sources:
WKZO – Portage acquires final land for Austin Lake Trail (Sept 12, 2025)
City of Portage 2024–2030 CIP – Bikeways & Trailways
City of Portage / Viridis – Austin Lake Trail Property Control Map (May 28, 2024)

features.n: KRVT east – Galesburg to Augusta (approx. alignment)
features.d:
Status (as of Oct 14, 2026): Not open. County/Parks Foundation say east-end construction resumes in 2026; RCKC CIP lists $1.5M for this trailway in 2026. An agreement with Amtrak on the two rail crossings was reached in 2025.
Facility: Kalamazoo River Valley Trail extension, ~4.5 mi
Alignment is the KATS planning line (approximate) – final route may differ. Starts at the east end of the existing KRVT (E6) segment.
